tools.name: scryfall_search_cards
tools.description: FREE tier. Search Magic cards with Scryfall syntax (e.g. 'o:flying t:dragon'). Returns ids, set info, and USD/EUR/TIX prices, plus Cardmarket/TCGplayer product ids for use with the paid-API tools. Requires no credentials.

tools.name: scryfall_card_prices
tools.description: FREE tier. Fuzzy-name card lookup returning all printings' prices (usd, usd_foil, eur, eur_foil, tix) from Scryfall bulk-derived data, updated daily. No credentials.

tools.name: cardmarket_product_search
tools.description: Search Cardmarket products by name (Magic by default, idGame=1). Requires your own Cardmarket API credentials in env (CARDMARKET_APP_TOKEN, CARDMARKET_APP_SECRET, CARDMARKET_ACCESS_TOKEN, CARDMARKET_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET). Read-only.

tools.name: cardmarket_price_guide
tools.description: Get the Cardmarket price guide (SELL, LOW, LOWEX, AVG, TREND, foil variants, 1/7/30-day averages) for a product id. Requires your own Cardmarket credentials. Read-only.

tools.name: cardmarket_compare_sellers
tools.description: Lists current offers for a Cardmarket product (cheapest first) with seller, country, condition, language, foil, quantity, plus price distribution stats. Optionally filter by min condition (MT,NM,EX,GD,LP,PL,PO), language id, foil, seller type. Requires your own Cardmarket credentials. Read-only.

tools.name: cardmarket_seller_stock
tools.description: Read-only view of a given Cardmarket seller's public stock (username or user id), optionally filtered by game and a name search, so you can compare their prices against market. Requires your own Cardmarket credentials.

tools.name: tcgplayer_product_search
tools.description: Search TCGplayer catalog products by name. Magic is categoryId 1. Requires your own TCGplayer API keys in env (TCGPLAYER_CLIENT_ID, TCGPLAYER_CLIENT_SECRET). Read-only. Note: TCGplayer is not currently issuing new API keys to everyone; this works only if you already have access.

tools.name: tcgplayer_price_guide
tools.description: Market/low/mid/high/direct-low prices per subtype (Normal/Foil) for up to 50 TCGplayer product ids. Requires your own TCGplayer keys. Read-only.

tools.name: reprice_suggest
tools.description: Suggests a new price for ONE of your listings. SUGGESTION ONLY — this server never creates, edits or deletes listings. Provide your current price plus either (a) marketplace='cardmarket' with idProduct (fetches live data with your creds), or (b) marketplace='manual' with your own reference numbers.
